Five fluffy white ducks stand together in shallow, rippling water, facing the viewer with oversized green eyes and broad orange bills. At the back left, one wears a red knit hat trimmed with thick white fur and stares straight ahead. In the center, a duck in a dark blue patterned hat holds its bill wide open. Behind them on the right, another wears a multicolored knit hat and black sunglasses. A fourth duck stands in front wearing a red hat with a white fur brim, its bill partly open. At the front right, the fifth wears a bright pom-pom hat and a blue hoodie with red lettering, its wings tucked into the hoodie’s pockets. Dark water fills most of the background, with a soft band of brown grasses along the far shore.

Scene/backdrop: a dim sensory installation where fine ivory silk threads hang vertically through faint lavender mist, while hidden magnets pull tiny iron-filament tassels into subtle curved fields that make invisible forces visible. Subject: one beautiful adult Latina woman with a short curly bob, fully clothed in a copper-brown high-collared tailored jacket, matching calf-length skirt, opaque tights and closed oxblood shoes; walking carefully between the threads with one palm held near a floating tassel, focused sideward gaze. Style/medium: cinematic installation-fashion photography, precise silk, mist and metal detail, natural skin texture, restrained analogue grain. Composition/framing: vertical 2:3, complete walking figure, eye-level medium distance, thread lines form a delicate field without obscuring face or hands. Constraints: one unmistakably adult woman, tasteful and nonsexual, opaque modest wardrobe, realistic anatomy and hands, no text, logo, watermark, brand, celebrity likeness, or imitation of any living artist. A loose watercolor and ink portrait fills the center of a cream, textured page. A pale figure with long, wispy gray hair faces forward, one visible eye glowing orange beneath heavy bangs. Her mouth opens impossibly wide across the left side of her face, exposing rows of pointed teeth and a long red tongue that curls downward. Red and black butterfly shapes flutter beside her mouth and above her head. At the upper right, two orange fish float among her hair; the larger fish overlaps a broad, black veined butterfly wing.
